title: Core parking bench
intro: Reproduce the measurements behind the RigPolice article https://rigpolice.com/system/articles/disable-cpu-core-parking/ . `parking-bench.ps1` measures frame pacing of a synthetic frame loop and the parked-core count in each power state; the CS2 load below is the CPU-bound real-game check.
needs: Run one state per series: stock, then the state you want to compare (for example after `cpu-parking-disabler.ps1`).
touch: only its own worker threads and a one-time calibration file `parking-bench-config.json` next to the script
